articles.title: Author Talks: Why founders misunderstand customer demand
articles.summary: Why do so many promising products fail to gain traction? A McKinsey alumnus explains why conventional thinking leads founders astray—and shares a practical framework for finding the “ideal” customer.

articles.title: How AI agents can help FP&A better steer the business
articles.summary: AI makes continuous financial planning practical at scale. Organizations can identify risks sooner, evaluate trade-offs faster, and intervene before performance gaps widen.

articles.title: How AI will reshape the economics of insurance: A CEO’s guide to strategy
articles.summary: AI could upend the industry’s long-standing structures and dynamics. Competitive advantage will accrue to carriers, distributors, and tech providers that prepare now.

articles.title: The human advantage in an AI economy
articles.summary: Tech investment alone won’t deliver a competitive edge. Organizations need systems that strengthen both brain health and AI-era skills so people can keep up with rising cognitive demands.

articles.title: Break to grow: Sanjiv Bajaj’s guiding business principle
articles.summary: Guided by his leadership North Star of “performing for today while transforming for tomorrow,” Sanjiv Bajaj believes in breaking businesses to grow, while fostering an entrepreneurial ethos.
